=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:929-937 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The post-loop error condition requires validation_dispatched = "false", so it only fires when no validation dispatch ever succeeded, and a later required dispatch failure is silently skipped after an earlier success.
  WHY: validation_dispatched is never reset after the first success, so the job exits 0 although a required validation failed to dispatch. Severity is BLOCKER from both reviewers. qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputes this finding (see its section).
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:~8558-8560 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The runtime test case later_dispatch_succeeds in test_post_merge_validate_dispatch_exit_status_after_loop expects exit 0 with no ::error::, which encodes the partial-success behavior as acceptable.
  WHY: The fixture uses a single global gh workflow run counter, so the case where an earlier issue succeeds and a later one fails cannot be reached. Severity is MAJOR.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:~8531 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The static test test_post_merge_validate_dispatch_fails_closed_when_required_dispatch_fails never asserts that the elif line excludes validation_dispatched.
  WHY: The validation_dispatched = "false" guard therefore passes the test, so the contract test does not enforce the intended fail-closed behavior. Severity is MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4466-4487 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Phase 7 no-run diagnostic prints CANDIDATE_RUNS_JSON fields untruncated.
  WHY: A large run listing could produce a long log group on the failure path. The impact is cosmetic only. Severity is NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: BUG-001 in analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md (~line 1387): "the `post-merge-validate-dispatch` job now fails, keeping the label, when required validation could not be dispatched."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml post-loop elif branch (lines 932-934) and companion tests in tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The elif reads `[ "${validation_dispatched}" = "false" ] && [ -n "${validation_required_seen}" ] && [ -n "${validation_dispatch_failed}" ]`, so it short-circuits whenever any earlier dispatch succeeded, and the later_dispatch_succeeds test asserts that behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:929-937 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The error condition `[ "${validation_dispatched}" = "false" ] && [ -n "${validation_required_seen}" ] && [ -n "${validation_dispatch_failed}" ]` only detects a failure if no validation was ever successfully dispatched.
  WHY: If one required validation succeeds and a later one fails, validation_dispatched stays "true" and the final error check is bypassed, silently skipping the failed requirement.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:932-934 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new elif requires validation_dispatched = "false", but that flag is set to "true" by the first successful dispatch and never reset, so a later required dispatch failure leaves the job green.
  WHY: With two required issues where #11 fails and #12 succeeds, neither the ::error:: nor the ::warning:: branch fires and the job exits 0, although #11's required validation never ran.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:~8558-8560 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The later_dispatch_succeeds runtime case expects exit 0 with no ::error::, which encodes the partial-success bug as acceptable.
  WHY: The fixture's single global gh workflow run counter cannot simulate "issue #11 succeeds, issue #12 fails", so the bug case is unreachable from the current tests.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:~8531 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The static test only checks that the elif line contains validation_dispatch_failed and validation_required_seen, and never asserts that validation_dispatched is absent.
  WHY: A guard on validation_dispatched passes the test, so the contract does not enforce the stated effect.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4466-4487 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The Phase 7 no-run diagnostic prints CANDIDATE_RUNS_JSON fields untruncated.
  WHY: A large listing could produce a long log group on the failure path. The impact is cosmetic only.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: BUG-001 in analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md (~line 1387): "the `post-merge-validate-dispatch` job now fails, keeping the label, when required validation could not be dispatched."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml post-loop elif branch (lines 932-934) and companion tests in tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: The elif reads `[ "${validation_dispatched}" = "false" ] && ...`, so the failure path short-circuits after any prior success, and the later_dispatch_succeeds test asserts that behavior.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: Drop the validation_dispatched clause from the elif, update the later_dispatch_succeeds test to expect rc=1 with ::error::, and make the fake gh fail per issue. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5
